about: Test fixture for build_pack.py: a well-formed plan for the two fixture risks. The test breaks copies of it.
title: Procurement compliance (fixture)

sections.heading: Background
sections.text: The spend analytics found {{$.tests.split_purchases.general_procurement.groups}} general procurement supplier groups whose combined payments cross a tier that each payment stays under [metric:$.tests.split_purchases.general_procurement.groups], and {{$.tests.expired_notice_spend.counts.flagged}} suppliers paid after their only notices ended [metric:$.tests.expired_notice_spend.counts.flagged]. These are risk indicators to investigate.

sections.heading: Objective
sections.text: To assess whether the controls over aggregation of requirements [rule:CPR-07] and contract extensions [rule:CPR-58] operate as the Contract Procedure Rules require.

sections.heading: Approach
sections.text: {{$.pack.scope.in_scope}} approved risks, {{$.pack.scope.controls}} expected controls and {{$.pack.scope.tests}} tests; {{$.pack.scope.sample_units}} sample units with {{$.pack.scope.transactions_sampled}} transactions worth {{$.pack.scope.sampled_value_gbp}} are drawn from the analytics. The largest test, T-01.1, takes {{$.pack.tests["T-01.1"].sample_units}} of {{$.pack.tests["T-01.1"].population_units}} groups.

controls.description: Requisitioners aggregate the value of one requirement across orders before choosing the procedure, and do not divide a requirement to avoid the Rules [rule:CPR-07].

At the aggregated value, quotations are invited through the Procurement Portal at the three-quotes tier [rule:CPR-49] and a contract notice is published [rule:CPR-50]; above the App B row C boundary a full tender is run [rule:CPR-53].

tests.title: Groups crossing the three-quotes tier
tests.step: For each sampled group, establish from the invoices and orders whether the payments meet one requirement; if they do, obtain the quotations and contract notice for the aggregated value [rule:CPR-49] [rule:CPR-50].

sample.rationale: Largest groups first: the value at stake is highest and the placement caveat does not apply to these tags.

tests.title: Groups at the one-quote tier
tests.step: For each sampled group, confirm whether the payments are one requirement and, if so, that at least one quote was sought for the combined value [rule:CPR-48] [metric:$.tests.split_purchases.general_procurement.groups].

sample.rationale: Evenly spread across the value range, one group per supplier.

tests.title: Walkthrough of how requirements are aggregated
tests.step: Walk through how a service estimates the total value of a requirement before ordering [rule:CPR-07].

sample.reason: Walkthrough with the Procurement team; no transactions are pulled.

controls.description: An extension provided for in the contract is approved by the S151 Officer before spend continues past the original end date [rule:CPR-58].

tests.title: Spend after the last notice ended
tests.step: For every flagged supplier, obtain the extension and its S151 Officer approval, or a newer contract and its notice [rule:CPR-58] [metric:$.tests.expired_notice_spend.counts.flagged].

sample.rationale: The population is small, so every supplier is tested.

pbc.item: Purchase orders and invoices for each sampled payment
Quotation records and contract notice for each sampled group, or the waiver relied on
Procedure notes or guidance on estimating the value of a requirement
Contract, extension and S151 Officer approval, or the newer contract and notice, for each flagged supplier

rules_not_tested.reason: Outside the two risks in this fixture.
